description: Source-comment removal, one workspace package at a time: census every comment, classify it (tautology, excuse, stale, decision record, hazard, narration, grouping, license), verify, delete what the code already says, move decisions into decision files, turn excuses into fixes or deduplicated issues, and lower the comment ratchet. Use on `/delete-comment <package>`, "delete the comments in X", "strip code comments", "run comment law on X", or when the comment ratchet fails. NOT for pull-request review comments or threads (yeet), public JSDoc authoring (jsdoc-annotation-specialist), or schema refactors (crispen).
